description: Adaptive Surface 0.12.2 replaces generic entity transition overlays with native BlockEntity visuals using unchanged block-space upper meshes and cube-centre anchoring.
changes: Preload render-only BlockTypes with Cutout opacity and shared native transition textures; no Item assets or voxel writes.
Replace ModelUpdate path with native BlockUpdate; restore original 32-unit block meshes and centre the entity on all three axes.
Remove the 42 obsolete generic-entity models; retain material rules, matching edges, bounded scanning and all attachment code.
advantages: Uses the same asset consumer as native blocks and already supported block decorations
No live registrations, extra creative items or F interception
disadvantages: Adds render-only BlockTypes and a small shared texture cost to the block atlas at startup
test_results: M3 sample checked before expanding to 42 meshes; 4902 native texels and four yaw/centre transforms passed
Five native boots PASS in test-transitions-v0122-a: transition create/reopen, nine addon secondary inputs, attachment create/reopen
Native block login packets serialize; no Item assets for helpers, no generic ModelComponent, no Velocity, no runtime registration
1724 resources unchanged; attachment and placement classes byte-identical; 42 generic models replaced by native block meshes
Read-only current-world audit: 7274496 base pixels plus 409600 transition-cache pixels, combined 7684096 under project budget 10000000; not total GPU memory
Installed SHA256 6a44830da7d883f4ac9c8fd410907a2002d9c020cae58a7f005bb56e7eac20ac; old JAR backed up; no save writes
